text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One night during summer camp, while I'm out walking along the beach, listening to the waves crash on the shore…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Fwahhh! Pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A soaking-wet Yaeno Muteki suddenly emerges from the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. I'm just finishing up some traditional Kongo Yaegaki underwater training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: First… you dive underwater, get a firm grip on some rocks at the bottom with your toes, and take position!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Then you slide forward one step at a time, unleashing dozens of basic strikes as you go! In other words, it's a martial arts performance in pure darkness!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Breaks are not permitted, of course. And if you lose your grip on the rocks for any reason and float toward the surface, you have to start again from the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Success is impossible unless you're able to stay calm in the dark and manage your breathing. One might call it the ultimate test.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's meant to be performed in a full set of armor, but if I can manage just this much, the improvement to my cardio and strength should be invaluable in a race!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Which is all to say… I'm going back under! Osu!
choice_data_list: At least let me tie a safety rope to you.
At least let me tie a safety rope to you.
Could you maybe do that… another time?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Which is all to say… I'm going back under! Osu!
choice_data_list: At least let me tie a safety rope to you.
At least let me tie a safety rope to you.
Could you maybe do that… another time?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Understood! I'll get a rope right away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once she's ready again, I wait on the beach, watching as columns of water, presumably from some attack, occasionally erupt from the ocean surface. Until…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hwaaah! Osu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Success! I did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A martial arts performance in pure darkness is much like a battle with one's own self. I feel like I've come to know the meaning of "true devotion" all over again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That alone made this all worth it. Thank you for letting me do this training! Osu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I felt pretty nervous while I was waiting for her, but it looks like Yaeno Muteki's training has paid off!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pwaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can't do it! Did I misjudge how quickly to let the air out of my lungs?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Again! I'm going to try one more time! This time I've got it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Fine. But I'll definitely get it next time we come to the beach!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm… I suppose I should train specifically with races in mind during summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In that case, is there something else I could be doing right now? Should I go back to the campsite?
choice_data_list: If you'd like, we could go for a short walk.
If you'd like, we could go for a short walk.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm… Yes, if that's all right. Now that I take a closer look, this area is quite beautiful in its tranquility.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I just remembered something a certain practitioner once said. "One must pick up the brush to master the sword." In other words, one must understand many arts to excel in combat.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Since we're in such a beautiful place, maybe I should take this opportunity to compose a haiku. Let's see…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The sea is pretty. The stars are pretty, also. I am happy now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Never mind. Forget I said anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, we walk along the beach for a while before returning to the campgrounds.
